loader_jobs.title: Financial pilot loader jobs
loader_jobs.description: M7C1: create BigQuery jobs in the pilot project. Project scope is the only scope jobs.create has. Granted only with an expiring condition.

loader_objects.title: Financial pilot loader objects
loader_objects.description: M7C1: create-only upload and read-back of packet objects. No list, delete, overwrite or bucket rights. Granted with expiry and packet-prefix conditions.

loader_tables.title: Financial pilot loader input tables
loader_tables.description: M7C1: load into and read back the three existing input tables. No create, update, delete or IAM rights. Granted per table with an expiring condition.
